# AudioRap — Album Cover Art Extractor & Audio Spectrogram Analyzer
> https://audiorap.com

AudioRap is a free, private, client-side web application for music producers, audio archivists, and audiophiles. It extracts embedded high-resolution album cover art from digital audio files and renders deep-frequency audio spectrograms to verify genuine lossless FLAC/WAV audio quality versus fake upsampled 128kbps/320kbps MP3 transcodes.

## Core Capabilities
- **Album Cover Art Extraction**: Decodes embedded ID3v2 APIC, Vorbis METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE, and MP4 cover art from MP3, FLAC, WAV, M4A, and OGG tracks without compression loss.
- **Audio Spectrogram Generation**: Full-resolution frequency analysis up to 22.05 kHz using the Web Audio API. Instantly reveals high-frequency shelf cutoffs characteristic of lossy MP3 compression.
- **Batch Processing**: Drag-and-drop multiple tracks for rapid inspection and single-click ZIP export.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All decoding and spectrogram rendering executes locally in the browser — audio never leaves the user's computer.
- **Studio Monitoring Gear**: Curated reference monitors, studio headphones, and USB audio interfaces for producers and engineers.

## Key URLs
- Homepage & Audio Tool: https://audiorap.com/
